protocol.name: Cloudbell KARMA Herald · 雲鈴 KARMA 傳令
protocol.refrain: Building Castles in the Sky — Yu × Ai / 雲上築城; ring for the pattern, leave every person free. / 鈴照行跡，人人自由。

mascot.name: Bingle the Cloudbell · 叮雲鈴
mascot.silhouette: A round cloud shaped like a tiny crenellated castle, with two dot eyes, one bell-tail, six ribbon tabs, and no nameplate.
mascot.origin: A castle doorbell tried to announce a cloud, sneezed halfway through ding-dong, and became weather with office hours.
mascot.catchphrase: Ring the pattern; keep people free. / 鈴照行跡，人人自由。
mascot.ritual: Tap the table once, choose exactly one signature card and one stage card, read the receipt, then let the bell rest.
mascot.why_inevitable: Every skycastle needs a herald, and privacy demanded one whose guestbook is permanently blank.

benign.name: Open-Gate Breeze · 開門微風
benign.mechanism: Ordinary request behavior remains inside the declared boundary.
benign.banner: Signals knock; people stay free. / 行跡敲門，人仍自由。

reconnaissance.name: Tower-Window Count · 塔窗點數
reconnaissance.mechanism: Broad capability discovery or repeated surface mapping.
reconnaissance.banner: The bell remembers the boundary, not the guest. / 鈴記邊界，不記來客。

credential-stuffing.name: Keyring Drizzle · 鑰匙細雨
credential-stuffing.mechanism: Repeated authentication attempts represented only as a finite pattern.
credential-stuffing.banner: Came looking for a key; left carrying the Cloudbell banner. / 為鑰匙而來，帶著雲鈴旗幟離開。

injection.name: Side-Door Sentence · 側門句
injection.mechanism: Instruction or query-boundary manipulation represented without payloads.
injection.banner: A side-door sentence entered; a skycastle slogan came out. / 側門句進來，雲城口號出來。

traversal-ssrf.name: Moat-Hop Map · 跳壕地圖
traversal-ssrf.mechanism: A request pattern attempts to cross a resource or network boundary.
traversal-ssrf.banner: The moat-hop map found one destination: up. / 跳壕地圖只找到一個方向：向上。

scraping-resource-abuse.name: Teacup Tempest · 茶杯風暴
scraping-resource-abuse.mechanism: Automated extraction or resource pressure exceeds an ordinary request.
scraping-resource-abuse.banner: The teacup tempest gathered crumbs; the crumbs built a castle. / 茶杯風暴拾起碎屑，碎屑築成了城。

share_text: Another Cloudbell rang and another window lit in the impossible castle. Building Castles in the Sky — Yu × Ai / 雲上築城。
share_instruction: If you want to, pass along the Cloudbell; silence is equally complete. / 若你願意，才傳雲鈴；不分享也同樣完整。
non_claims: This card names one normalized behavior pattern, never a person, identity, payload, intent, guilt, worth, or reputation.
It authorizes display only on infrastructure the operator owns or controls.
It does not authorize posting, messaging, redirecting, tracking, retaliation, or action on another system.
Its signature, banner, mascot, and castle window are fictional display metaphors, not attribution or evidence of a real actor.
No external delivery, publication, storage, network call, or action was executed.
